messages:
Elaine W: Quick heads-up, onboarding request for `orca-mini-licensed-v2`. Model card in S3 but missing license + attribution, so compliance gate blocked staging deploy :grimacing:
Samir K: Where are the weights? I can sort perms.
Elaine W: s3://redwood-models/onboard/orca-mini-licensed-v2/ — tokenization files and model_card.yaml are present but `license` is blank and no `attribution`.
Matt H: Ran a quick tokenizer smoke test — punctuation splitting is off (periods tokenized oddly). Command I used:
```
python -m scripts.tokenizer_check \
  --vocab s3://redwood-models/onboard/orca-mini-licensed-v2/tokenizer_vocab.json \
  --expected tests/expected_vocab.json
```
Liz P: CI failing on `config_validation` step: errors `missing_field: license` and `tokenizer_vocab_mismatch`.
ComplianceBot: Automated policy: onboarding must include model_card.yaml with fields `license`, `attribution`, `allowed_use_cases`, `export_restrictions`. See https://redwood.internal/docs/model-onboarding/compliance-gates
Samir K: Upstream README mentions "custom non-commercial". Legal prefers SPDX when possible. What should we set until legal signs off?
Elaine W: Do not accept ambiguous phrasing. For now use `license: RESTRICTED-NONCOMMERCIAL` + attach upstream LICENSE text. Add `export_restrictions: ["EAR"]`. Also populate `attribution` with upstream repo URL and authors.
Matt H: Tokenizer fix: their vocab uses a byte-escape for `.` whereas our tests expect `.` as a token. I'll open a tiny PR to map their `\u002e` entry to `.` in tokenizer_merges. That should clear `tokenizer_vocab_mismatch`.
Samir K: I'll add model_card.yaml with placeholder license + attribution and push ACL change. Will include exact SHA for weights. PR soon.
Elaine W: Also include a `weight_manifest.json` alongside the weights with keys: `s3_path`, `sha256`, `size_bytes`, `checkpoint_format`. Example to follow in PR.
Matt H: For S3 policy, apply deny for non-HTTPS and require KMS decrypt via our IAM role. Minimal snippet in PR.
Liz P: Adding gating checklist to ticket #3421. New checklist item: `model_card.license_spdx OR model_card.license_repo_link`. Also record CI logs.
Samir K: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/onboarding/pulls/789 — includes model_card.yaml, weight_manifest.json, bucket ACL update. Current CI fail is tokenizer mismatch.
Elaine W: Great. @Matt H please review tokenizer mapping PR. Samir, when green, ping legal and attach upstream LICENSE to speed sign-off.
Matt H: I'll review in ~30m :+1:
Samir K: Will add attribution string with upstream repo + commit SHA, attach LICENSE, and update PR comment for legal.
Elaine W: After legal confirms, we'll flip license from placeholder to the approved SPDX or internal wrapper and re-run compliance gates. Re-running gating after PR merges.
Liz P: Noted. I'll update ticket and mark owner.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: allowed_use_cases must explicitly list permitted categories (example: `research`, `assistive-tools`) and prohibited categories (example: `biometric-identification`, `autonomous-weapons`).
Elaine W: Closing loop here — thanks everyone. Follow-up actions: Samir (PR + attach LICENSE), Matt (tokenizer PR review), Liz (ticket checklist), Legal (finalize license wording).
